faq: Should I build login myself or use a service?
Services such as Auth0, Clerk, Firebase or Supabase Auth save time and handle security updates. We help you choose, or build your own with trusted libraries if you prefer.
Next.js, React, Vue, Laravel, Django, Rails and plain Node.js are common for us. Tell us your stack and we match it, so your team can maintain the code.
Do you store my users' passwords?
Passwords are stored only as salted hashes, never as plain text, and are never visible to us. Everything runs in your own project and hosting account.
Can you add this to an app that already has users?
Yes. We plan how existing accounts continue to work, then add the new login without forcing anyone to start over. The plan is agreed in writing first.
